newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Infratil NTA NZ$1.12/shr as at Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: Infratil NTA NZ$1.12/shr as at Sept 9.

text.p: Infrastructure and Utilities NZ Ltd on Monday said as at September 9 its net tangible asset backing was NZ$1.12/share based on market prices at that date.
The NTA was undiluted for options after allowing for tax on unrealised gains in Infratil Securities.
The market value of Infratil's portfolio (adjusted for tax on holdings in Infratil Securities Ltd) was approximately NZ$187 million. In addition, the company had cash of $23 million.
